entities.name: UAC-0002
entities.gloss: A Russian state-sponsored cyber espionage and sabotage group also known as Sandworm, APT44, and Seashell Blizzard.

entities.name: UAC-0133

entities.name: UAC-0212
entities.gloss: A sub-cluster of UAC-0002 targeting industrial control system developers and critical infrastructure supply chains.

newRelationTypes.name: subcluster-of
newRelationTypes.definition: Identifies an activity group or cluster as an operational subgroup or affiliated component of a broader threat group.

newRelationTypes.name: exploits-vulnerability
newRelationTypes.definition: Indicates that a threat actor leverages a software vulnerability during their attack operations.

newRelationTypes.name: uses-tool
newRelationTypes.definition: Denotes that a threat actor or group deploys or executes a specific software tool or malware family.

newRelationTypes.name: targets-country
newRelationTypes.definition: Indicates that a threat actor conducts cyber operations against victims located in a specific country.

newRelationTypes.name: exfiltrates-to-ip
newRelationTypes.definition: Indicates that a tool or malware transmits stolen data to a specific destination IP address.

newRelationTypes.name: abuses-account
newRelationTypes.definition: Denotes that an attacker compromises and uses an email or system account to facilitate further attacks.

newRelationTypes.name: hosts-payload
newRelationTypes.definition: Indicates that an internet domain or network asset is used to deliver or manage specific malware.
